# RUMC machine recipe guide
[textlink="Back to Mining & Industry" link="CMUGuideIndustry"] · [textlink="ASRS Sell Prices" link="CMUGuideIndustryPrices"]
Every product currently made by a RUMC production machine or work station is listed below. Use the search box above to filter by product, ingredient, process or machine. This catalog reads the same prototypes as the machines, so new recipes appear here automatically.
Expand [bold]Recipe[/bold] for exact inputs, outputs, processing time, circuit setting, temperature, reusable mold or catalyst, and compatible equipment. Expand [bold]Sources[/bold] for other known ways to obtain that product. Items marked [bold]kept[/bold] are not consumed.
Blue ingredient links jump to that material's card when it is made by another RUMC machine. The quantities shown are per batch; upgrades and machine speed can change processing time.
